title: CanonicalConsentRecord
description: Internal canonical shape every source_event is transformed into (step 2) and validated against (step 3). Carries both consent (purpose-based, compliance) and preferences (topic+channel, granular choice) as distinct concepts. purposeCode/topicCode/channel are intentionally free strings here, not enums — validity is checked at runtime against the external taxonomy reference (S3 source of truth, read via Redis), so new codes are a data change, not a schema change.

header.description: Pipeline/envelope metadata. Kept separate from subject so envelope changes don't ripple into consent/preference mapping logic.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this canonical contract, e.g. '1.0'.

eventId.description: Carried from the source event's eventId.

eventType.description: Carried from the source event, e.g. 'event_registration', 'account_registration'.

sourceSystem.description: Carried from the source event, e.g. 'cvent', 'vanguard-portal'.

occurredAt.description: Carried from the source event: when the underlying action happened on the source side.

correlationId.description: Carried from source_event.provenance.correlationId; when the source didn't send one, step 2 sets it to the eventId so every record is traceable.

processedAt.description: When the Step Function processed this event into canonical form. Distinct from occurredAt/capturedAt, which describe the source-side timing.

identifierType.description: Normalized identifier type, e.g. 'email', 'memberId', 'clientId'. Sources may spell this inconsistently (e.g. 'member_id' vs 'memberId') — transform normalizes to one fixed spelling.

consent.description: Legal/compliance permission decisions, one per purpose.

purposeCode.description: Taxonomy-checked purpose code (not enumerated here — see taxonomy reference).

legalBasis.description: Optional. Legal basis for this purpose (e.g. 'consent', 'contract', 'legitimate_interest'), derived during transform from the taxonomy mapping rather than sent by the source.

captureMethod.description: Carried from the source: how the consent was captured (e.g. 'web_form_checkbox'). Kept because it's part of the consent's compliance evidence.

preferences.description: Granular topic+channel choices. Distinct from consent: a preference is a delivery choice, not necessarily a legal permission.

topicCode.description: Taxonomy-checked topic code (not enumerated here — see taxonomy reference).

channel.description: Comms/delivery channel, e.g. 'email', 'sms'. Taxonomy-checked. Not to be confused with provenance.captureChannel.

provenance.description: Traceability data, carried forward from source_event.provenance for the OneTrust record/audit trail.

captureChannel.description: How the user interacted when this event was captured (web/mobile/in_person). Capture context, not a comms channel.
